annotations.title: ToolFit: Preflight a remote MCP server (MCPCheck)

description:
Does this remote MCP server work, and is it worth connecting or paying for? Sends initialize and tools/list only (never calls a tool) and reports reachability, protocol version, sign-in method (OAuth protected-resource metadata), x402 payment terms if it asks for payment, latency, tool count and token cost, provider compatibility, poisoning patterns in tools and server instructions, issues and a grade A-F, plus a pin for later diffs. https public hosts only. Free: 10 checks/day per IP, then $0.005 via x402 or credits.

[ToolFit via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as ToolFit's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: check $0.005 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

tier.description: Paid tier: check $0.005. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.

url.description: Public remote MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, https), e.g. https://api.youraitools.co/mcp/hub. ToolFit only lists its tools.
